I don't have Nvidia's reported fiscal Q1 2027 results (quarter ended around April 2026), so this is an estimate rather than a reported figure.

The estimate builds on the most recent trend and guidance I know of:
- Nvidia's GAAP operating margin was about 63% in fiscal Q3 2026 and about 65% in fiscal Q4 2026.
- Management's guidance for fiscal Q1 2027 pointed to revenue of roughly $78 billion and a gross margin of about 75%.
- That implies gross profit of about $58 billion. Subtracting GAAP operating expenses of about $7.5–8 billion leaves operating income of about $50–51 billion.
- Dividing that by revenue gives an operating margin of about 65%.
